home.heroSubtitle: Nawat Alalmas Holding Company — a diversified investment platform founding leading Saudi brands across technology, health, mobility, and commerce.
home.introText: Nawat Alalmas Holding Company is a private Saudi holding company headquartered in Riyadh, building a diversified portfolio of brands and digital platforms that serve the local market and align with Saudi Vision 2030. Founded in 2024 with an entrepreneurial mindset and a national ambition, we are positioned as one of the drivers of economic transformation in the Kingdom.
home.brandsSubtitle: Three Saudi brands built on real data and genuine market needs
home.visionText: To become the most impactful holding group in shaping the Saudi digital economy through real brands that solve real problems.
home.sectorsSubtitle: We choose our sectors deliberately — where the impact is greatest and the opportunity is clearest
home.ctaText: Whether you are an investor, a potential partner, or a talent looking for an environment to grow — Nawat Alalmas is a place worth being.

about.pageSubtitle: A Saudi holding company that believes the real economy is built through bold ideas and precise execution
about.storyP1: Nawat Alalmas was not born from a vacuum — it was born from a clear conviction that the Saudi market needs young, agile, data-driven holding groups.
about.storyP2: Founded in 2024 in Riyadh, the company began by selecting sectors with genuine impact: technology, health, mobility, and commerce. Not random diversification — but a portfolio built with deliberate strategic intent.
about.storyP3: Our name is not decoration — a diamond is forged under immense pressure and emerges pure, hard, and of exceptional value. That is how we build our companies.
about.value1Text: We do not launch a product we are not proud of. Every detail reflects the standard of professionalism we hold ourselves to.
about.value2Text: We ask the difficult questions. We challenge assumptions. And we build solutions no one has thought of yet.
about.value3Text: We select our opportunities based on the scale of the problem they solve, because genuine impact is what creates lasting value.
about.value4Text: We speak clearly with our partners, our team, and our community. No ambiguity in values. No fog in vision.
about.value5Text: We build with Saudi hands for a Saudi market — with deep cultural understanding and genuine national ambition that cannot be replicated.
about.value6Text: The market evolves constantly. We build teams that learn fast, experiment boldly, and adapt intelligently.
about.timeline1Text: Nawat Alalmas Holding Company established in Riyadh with a clear identity and defined strategic vision.
about.timeline2Text: Launch of Preem — our first active brand in the mobility and automotive services sector.
about.timeline3Text: Launch of Noor Auto Hub and Frashah — expanding the portfolio to include operational technology and women's health.
about.timeline4Text: Expansion into new sectors and building strategic partnerships that reinforce the group's national standing.

companies.pageSubtitle: Real Saudi brands solving real problems

preem.name: Preem
preem.description: Preem is a Saudi platform that brings together mobile car wash service providers in one place, making it easier for customers to discover, compare, and book services that best fit their needs. The platform offers a seamless, modern experience connecting customers with trusted providers through one unified system.

frashah.name: Frashah
frashah.description: Frashah is a Saudi women's wellness brand focused on supporting comfort and balance during the menstrual cycle through carefully crafted natural herbal products. Our products combine quality, nature, and elegant design to help women feel supported, confident, and well every month.

noor.name: Noor Auto Hub
noor.tagline: Smart Management System for Car Washes
noor.description: Noor Auto Hub builds smart management systems for car wash centers. Our platform gives owners complete visibility into their operations — from automatically counting cars using AI cameras, to managing sales, inventory, staff scheduling, and customer appointments — all in one place.

vision.pageSubtitle: Every brand we build begins here
vision.visionText: To become the most impactful holding group in shaping the Saudi digital economy through real brands that solve real problems and build lasting value.
vision.missionText: We build leading Saudi brands that combine entrepreneurial thinking with institutional execution — brands the Kingdom is proud of and can compete with globally.
vision.vision2030Text: Nawat Alalmas is part of the Kingdom's broader economic transformation. We believe the Saudi private sector is the true engine of Vision 2030, and everything we build serves that direction.
vision.pillar1Text: We engage the mind before deploying capital. Every venture begins with a deep understanding of the problem and a solution that does not resemble what came before.
vision.pillar2Text: We build for the Saudi market from within — with a Saudi mindset and a genuine cultural understanding that cannot be replicated from the outside.
vision.pillar3Text: We do not chase rapid growth at the expense of quality. We build for decades, not for a quarter.
vision.pillar4Text: A company is its people. We invest in individuals because everything else can be built later.

chairman.pageSubtitle: A vision built on genuine conviction
chairman.comingSoonText: The Chairman's message will be published shortly. We are committed to ensuring it reflects the authentic vision that guides this group.

services.pageSubtitle: We build companies, not just products
services.introText: Nawat Alalmas is not a traditional services company — we found, operate, and develop brands from within. We combine the mindset of venture capital with the operational discipline of a mature holding group.
services.service1Text: From idea to launch — we build the brand entirely from scratch: identity, platform, team, and strategy.
services.service2Text: We invest in startups and platforms that align with our portfolio and enhance its overall value.
services.service3Text: Our companies do not operate in isolation — we provide support in technology, marketing, human resources, and governance.
services.service4Text: We seek partnerships with government entities and the private sector to amplify the impact of our brands and extend their reach.
services.partnerText: We look for visionaries who want to build something real in the Saudi market — those with a bold idea, execution energy, and a passion for impact. If that is you, let us talk.

portfolio.pageSubtitle: Three brands — the beginning of an ambitious portfolio
portfolio.introText: Each company in our portfolio represents a deliberate strategic decision — a clear sector, a genuine problem, a solution that has not been built properly before.
portfolio.futureText: Nawat Alalmas is evaluating additional sectors for investment and development. Our portfolio is in continuous evolution — and every year brings new opportunities worth building.

privacy.pageSubtitle: We respect your privacy and protect your data
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Nawat Alalmas Holding Company and its subsidiary platforms collect, use, protect, and handle information in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
privacy.section1Text: We may collect the following information when you use our platforms or contact us: name and contact details (email, phone number), usage and browsing data, booking and transaction data, any information you voluntarily share with us.
privacy.section2Text: We use collected information for purposes including: operating and improving our services and platforms, communicating with you regarding your inquiries and requests, sending relevant information and updates with your consent, complying with legal and regulatory requirements.
privacy.section3Text: We do not sell your personal data to any third party. We may share information with service providers who assist us in operating our platforms under strict data protection agreements, or when legally required by court order or regulatory mandate.
privacy.section4Text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, or deletion.
privacy.section5Text: Under the PDPL, you have the right to access your personal data, correct it, request its deletion, or object to its processing. You may exercise these rights by contacting us at admin@nah.sa.
privacy.section6Text: Our platforms use cookies to enhance your experience and analyze usage patterns. You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences.
privacy.section7Text: For any inquiry related to this Privacy Policy or your personal data, please contact us at: admin@nah.sa
